title: Coconut Paneer Bites with Avocado Salsa
description: A unique fusion of Indian and Mexican flavors, with crispy coconut paneer bites served with a creamy avocado salsa. Perfect as a snack or appetizer.
instructions: Cut the paneer into small cubes and set aside.
In a bowl, mix together coconut flakes and nutty spice blend.
Dip each paneer cube into the coconut mixture, coating evenly.
Heat oil in a pan and fry the coated paneer cubes until golden brown.
Meanwhile, mash the avocados in a bowl and mix with sweet chili sauce.
Serve the crispy paneer bites with the creamy avocado salsa.
Garnish with additional coconut flakes and nutty spice blend if desired.
